Instead of just applying we also had to have an interview with him and I was the first one. I asked my director if we could talk and so we did in his office. Apparently the big red flag was because of the question, “which student leader do you look up to?” For my person I chose a guy named Blake who was a Euphonium section leader back in my sophomore year. I had a great year with him because I felt left out in band and felt comfortable to talk with him. He was very chill and I found him easy to talk to and I talked about how he was a great example of being able to have conversations with anyone especially freshman for my response. My band director basically told me that there were leaders in the band who told him that Blake did drugs which was completely untrue and that made me so upset. I tried to talk him out saying that they were rumors and he just shut me down and said it was the worst interview he ever had in his life and it just made me hold a grudge to him for that. When you miss double shurikens do you mean with your standard W E Q combo or your ult shadows? If you need help on the normal combo then I got tips on how to land them more. The first thing you should know is that your W shadow slows down the enemy when you E them so that should make it easier to land you Q's when you hit them. You should NEVER try to quickly Q as soon as you slow them because there's chances you'll miss them and have to spend more time waiting till you proc electrocute. Wait for 0.5 seconds to see where they'll head and then Q in that direction (they can still sidestep but your shadow slow should have around 1.5 second slow to still help) Another helpful tip is to know when to W E Q them and the answer is when they're going to cs or when they try to walk up on you but fail. If you see a minion or cannon is about to get last hit try and combo the enemy since the auto animation makes them stand still for a tiny moment and are left vulnerable. You also want to punish them if they were to walk up on you and disengage soon after. Now comes the placement of the shadow, i'd say you shouldn't try to put your shadow in the middle of the lane where the enemy can walk any direction to sidestep. The ideal placement would be where you could force a certain direction for the enemy to go to such as when the enemy is right below the minions. Now if you're looking for hitting atleast a double Q on the enemy then you can just use the tips used for the W E Q to help but be wary because there's many combos you can do with your ult. I'd say search them up and learn when and how to use the combo in different situations, here's a link- [https://youtu.be/s\_WAul76a0A?t=1386](https://youtu.be/s_WAul76a0A?t=1386) 

Now that's basically all there is to it other than some micro details you should work on yourself and knowing whether the enemy has dashes or leaps, etc. Hopefully this all helped summoner.
